title: Alternatives if customer change is not possible
raw_text:
9/30/26, 5:12 AM
e The business partners credit rating data is not transferred.

Alternatives if customer change is not possible
If a contract has not yet been invoiced, proceed as follows:

e Reverse the move-in document: Execute move-in with the correct business partner. You can use the move-in document as a
template.

e Create an intermediate bill.

e Wait for the next bill and then execute the customer change.

Objects and Enhancements in SAP CRM

Definition

If you integrate SAP S/4HANA Utilities with SAP CRM, you can use the data cleansing tool in SAP CRM to manage the business
partner merge cases and, to some extent, process them in SAP CRM.

Use

For the objects replicated between SAP CRM and SAP S/4HANA Utilities, the change is made to the target business partner in SAP
CRM. An exception to this is the contract in SAP CRM. Here, the change to the target business partner is triggered by the customer
change in SAP S/4HANA Utilities.

For more information about transfer functions for other objects in SAP Utilities, see Objects and Enhancements in SAP Utilities for
Business Partner Merging.

Automatic Business Partner Merging

Use

You can use BAPIs or BOR methods to automate individual steps of business partner merging. For further information on this, see
the SAP note 624341 (Merging Business Partners).

Features

You can use the following BAPIs for automatic business partner merging:

BAPI                                                                Description
BAPI_ISUACCOUNT_GETDETAIL                     Display contract account
BAPI_ISUACCOUNT_CHANGE                        Change contract account

BAPI_ISUPARTNER_GETDETAIL                      Display contract account
